_comment: The diner on Main Street (street.json, whose model, ground, lights and glow it shares): the racing hub's Diner drives
here. The positions are the street's (see street.json): x along Main Street, z across it, the diner's side towards -z.
The diner stands on the north-east corner of Main Street and the cross street (its middle at x = -36), its lot round
it: its front (the long glass side) at z = -15, its west side (the door) at x = -15. The racers' bays: a row along
its front just behind the sidewalk (5 m deep, z -9.5 to -14.5, lines every 3 m from x = -15 to 12), facing it, so
they are seen close from the player's curb across the street, and four along its west side
(x -15.5 to -20.5), facing it. Headings are degrees, 0 facing +z, 90 facing east (+x), 180 facing the diner.
arrive: from the west in Main Street's eastbound lane, through the crossing and into the parking lane across the
street from the diner, at the curb facing east; the car stops at the last point. backOut: a car's length back along
the curb, to pull out. leave: out of the parking lane and away east; the screen goes before it ends.
lookWhileParked: where the driver looks at the curb, degrees from straight ahead, to the left positive (the diner is
out of the side window, as in Street Rod); lookUpWhileParked: how far up, degrees, -15 to 15.
bays: where the racers at the diner have parked, in the order they are filled.
model, sun, lights, glow, credit: left out, the street's.
